caption: The video showcases a close-up of a press with yellow-and-black striped upper and lower platens against a plain gray wall. An open, C-shaped metal ring stands vertically between the platens, its cut ends facing upward. The upper platen is positioned over the upright ring, which remains whole. Then the ring breaks apart, bursting orange sparks outward as the left arc separates and is thrown toward the upper-left, exiting the frame. The right arc stays on the lower platen, its top end contacting the upper platen. Afterward the scene holds largely static, the upper platen resting against the remaining fragment while the sparks fade. The viewpoint and background remain consistent, the visible motion being the sparks scattering and the fragment's ejection.
